question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hostile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hospitable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hostile"** means unfriendly, antagonistic, or having an aggressive attitude towards others. (शत्रुतापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The hostile tone of his voice made it clear that he was upset.
 
 
 
• **"Hospitable"** refers to being friendly, welcoming, and generous to guests or strangers. (अतिथि सत्कार करनेवाला)
 
 
• **Example:** They were very hospitable and made us feel at home during our stay.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Hostile'** is **'Hospitable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hospitable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frigid **(जमाने वाला ठंडा): Extremely cold or lacking warmth in behavior.

 
 
• **Example:** Her frigid response showed she was not interested in continuing the conversation.
 
 
 
• **Antagonistic** (विरोधी): Showing opposition or hostility toward someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The two teams have always had an antagonistic rivalry.
 
 
 
• **Icy** (बर्फीला): Covered with ice or very cold in demeanor.
 
 
• **Example:** Her icy stare made him shiver with fear.
